note: The release gate's allowlist: a gating checker (run-checks.py CHECKS minus REPORT_ONLY) may fail at a release only when this file names every finding line it prints. run-checks.py applies it itself (tools/gate_allowlist.py), so a bare `python tools/run-checks.py` and refresh-safe.sh give the same verdict, and a pass over an allowlisted failure says `PASS with N allowlisted failure(s)`, never a bare PASS. Since r14 (3 November 2026, CHG-R14I-001; the r13 system review E-01, E-02, E-04): an entry carries `added`, `expires` (at most 14 days after `added`, CLAUDE.md rule 15), `approved_by` (the lead), `change` (the CHG-/CR- id) and `why`; each `known` pattern (Python regex, re.search) names ONE finding, never a count or a verdict line; a checker that crashed is never let through. An undated, unapproved, expired or count-pinned entry fails the gate itself (run-checks.py, and check-baseline-ratchet.py on every run). Emptied at r14: the three checkers listed until r13 (check-authored-inputs, check-screen-patterns, check-screen-permissions) had undated entries 14 to 33 days old and are fixed; the one entry since is the lead's dated exception of 3 November 2026 for the NP ratchet (CHG-R14I-012).
